changeSet.author: copilot
changeSet.comment: Create peers table for P2P networking
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE peers ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, device_id INTEGER REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_id VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL, ip_address VARCHAR(45), port INTEGER, certificate TEXT, capabilities JSONB, last_seen TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_super_node BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, public_ip_address VARCHAR(45), public_port INTEGER, dht_id VARCHAR(128), public_key TEXT, stun_server VARCHAR(255), turn_server VARCHAR(255), behind_nat BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE INDEX idx_peers_device ON peers(device_id); CREATE INDEX idx_peers_last_seen ON peers(last_seen); CREATE INDEX idx_peers_super_node ON peers(is_super_node) WHERE is_super_node = TRUE; CREATE INDEX idx_peers_dht_id ON peers(dht_id); CREATE INDEX idx_peers_public_ip ON peers(public_ip_address);

changeSet.author: copilot
changeSet.comment: Create p2p_statistics table for aggregate metrics
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE p2p_statistics ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, date DATE NOT NULL, total_transfers INTEGER DEFAULT 0, successful_transfers INTEGER DEFAULT 0, failed_transfers INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_bytes_transferred BIGINT DEFAULT 0, total_bandwidth_saved BIGINT DEFAULT 0, avg_transfer_time_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0, active_peers INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT unique_date UNIQUE (date) );
CREATE INDEX idx_p2p_stats_date ON p2p_statistics(date);

changeSet.author: copilot
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE host_availability ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, device_id INTEGER REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_id VARCHAR(64) REFERENCES peers(peer_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, is_available BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, hourly_rate DECIMAL(10, 2), currency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'USD', max_rental_hours INTEGER DEFAULT 24, device_specs JSONB, availability_schedule JSONB, total_rentals INTEGER DEFAULT 0, average_rating DECIMAL(3, 2), last_updated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE INDEX idx_host_availability_device ON host_availability(device_id); CREATE INDEX idx_host_availability_available ON host_availability(is_available) WHERE is_available = TRUE; CREATE INDEX idx_host_availability_rate ON host_availability(hourly_rate);
